capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Page says “110.3kWh battery” without saying gross or usable; recorded as gross.

chemistry.notes: Review says 110.3 kWh NMC pack (relayed; NCM/NMC are the same family). Same pack across the three variants.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: European listing for the same 110.3 kWh pack: 106.0 kWh usable (other sites say 106.3 or 107). Pack is common to all markets. Conflict: the awd and awd-performance records hold 99.5 kWh (OpenEV) for the same 110.3 kWh pack; not reconciled.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 owner's manual page (code MEa) describes manual plus navigation-automatic Battery Conditioning; the page does not name the model, ME being the IONIQ 9 platform code (inference), and no Canadian manual was read. Applied to all three IONIQ 9 powertrains.

ac_max_kw.notes: European listing: 11 kW (3-phase 16 A). Canadian onboard charger not confirmed on a Canadian page.

dc_max_kw.notes: Electrek review states up to ~237 kW on a 350 kW 800 V charger, not attributed to Hyundai; the same article measured nearly 215 kW. Third-party figures range 233-250 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: “Approximately 24 mins” 10–80% on a 350 kW charger; model-wide claim.
